title: We're wearing our new uniform!
vocab_topic: Clothes, school uniform and the family
pair_game: Point at a picture. Your partner says: “I am wearing a …”. Then swap!

grammar_box.title: Present continuous: now
rows: He **is not wearing** a tie today.
grammar_box.tip: Use the present continuous for NOW: I am wearing… (hozir)

questions: What are you wearing right now?
Are you wearing your school uniform today?
What color is your new uniform?
Who is your brother or sister?
What is your mom doing right now?
Do you like wearing a uniform? Why or why not?
What are you doing after school?
Is your dad at home now?
Tell me about your family. Who lives with you?
starters: Yes, I am wearing … . / No, I am wearing … .
My brother/sister is … . He/She is … years old.
Yes, they are. / No, they are not. They are wearing … .
I like / do not like wearing a uniform because … .
Yes, he is at home. / No, he is at … .
In my family there are … people. We are … .
samples: What are you wearing right now?
I **am wearing** my school uniform. It is a white shirt and grey trousers. My shoes are black.
What is your mom doing right now?
She **is cooking** in the kitchen. She **is making** soup. It smells very good!
Tell me about your family. Who lives with you?
I live with my mother, my father and my little sister. My grandmother lives with us too. We are five people.

game.title: Roll and say!
game.rules: Roll the dice. Say a sentence with the present continuous. One point for every good sentence!
items: 2 — Say what your friend is wearing.
3 — Say what your teacher is wearing.
4 — Say what your mother is doing now.
5 — Say what your friends are doing now.
6 — Say what you are NOT wearing today.

mini_talk.title: My uniform and my family
plan: Say if you like the uniform
mini_talk.model: Hello! My name is Sevara. Today I **am wearing** my new school uniform. It is a white shirt and a blue skirt. I like it because it is comfortable. I live with my mother, my father and my brother. My brother **is wearing** a uniform too!

say what my family is doing now
talk about the people in my family
